name: Raul Alfonso Guerrero
radio: 500+ radios over a lifetime — currently 100+ in active collection
favorite_freq: Voice of Free China (Radio Taiwan International) — where it all began
why: At age four I picked up my father's transistor radio and accidentally switched it to SW. I heard voices in completely unfamiliar languages and grasped that the signal was coming from far away. That moment never left me.
best_catch: A letter to Maria Francisca at The Voice of Free China led to my first QSL card — a large envelope stuffed with magazines, stickers, pennants, and a card that arrived two months later. I had no idea stations replied to mail.
